solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Drink cures heart-break

indicators.note: to break something is to smash it into pieces, so the letters of the words before it are reassembled

explanation.surface: Some tipple claims to mend a broken heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart-break' reads as one word of sorrow, but 'break' is the anagram signal working on CURES and HEART together.
explanation.definitionFit: Chartreuse is a French herbal liqueur made by Carthusian monks, so it is a drink.

clue.text: Hydrogen air-locks

parts.note: H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A technical note about airlocks in a hydrogen system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air-locks' looks like one engineering term; split it and 'locks' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Locks are tresses of growth on the head, a common synonym for what grows on the scalp.

clue.text: Rebel when told to get out of bed

definitions.meaning: to rebel is to revolt against those in power

definitions.text: told to get out of bed
definitions.meaning: the command a sleeper is given in the morning to stand up

explanation.definitionFit: To revolt is to rise against authority, and rising from bed is the literal sense.

clue.text: Going fast or simply standing

definitions.meaning: in British usage a candidate standing for office is in the race for it

explanation.definitionFit: Racing on foot is the literal sense; contesting an election, or standing, is the idiomatic one.

clue.text: Surgeon's inner drive

indicators.note: the inner part of the word is taken, so the letters lie inside it

explanation.surface: What motivates a doctor deep down.
explanation.definitionFit: An urge is an impulse or drive pushing someone to act.

clue.text: Beg for something nice to follow in French

indicators.note: one piece follows, so it is placed after the French word

parts.note: en is the French word for in
a treat is something nice to enjoy

explanation.surface: Asking for a pleasant dessert to come next at a French meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To plead with someone for a thing is to implore, a close synonym of begging for it.

clue.text: There may be plenty of jumpers at these second-hand stalls

definitions.text: There may be plenty of jumpers at these second-hand stalls

parts.words: There may be plenty of jumpers at these second-hand stalls
parts.note: jumpers reads as sweaters on sale, but also as the hopping insects in the market's name

explanation.definitionFit: A market of second-hand goods is known by a name featuring a hopping parasite, so jumping insects fit.

clue.text: Meat-pie can be served free

indicators.note: food served up is dished out in a new arrangement, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tinned pie can be dished up at no cost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' looks like 'at no charge' but is a verb meaning liberate.
explanation.definitionFit: To emancipate is to free someone from slavery or restriction.

clue.text: Squalid place where many people live, fifty in all

definitions.text: Squalid place where many people live

indicators.note: the Roman numeral sits in the word for all

parts.note: the sum is the total, all of it
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A crowded, squalid district holding fifty residents in total.
explanation.definitionFit: A slum is a squalid, overcrowded urban area where poor people live.

clue.text: Start of play

parts.note: reads as the beginning of a game, but means the opening evening of a theatrical production

explanation.definitionFit: The debut performance of a stage play is its opening evening.

clue.text: I may be in raging anger, but recover possession

indicators.note: the single letter goes in the scrambled word
something raging is wild and uncontrolled, so the following word's letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: Someone furious about losing something tries to win it back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raging' turns ANGER into REGAN, and 'in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To get back what was lost is to recover possession of it.

clue.text: Stay and use up the money oppressing you and me

indicators.note: to oppress is to weigh down on, so one word surrounds and bears down on the other

parts.note: to spend is to use up money
us means you and me

explanation.surface: Spending all our cash weighs heavily on us.
explanation.walkthrough: Stay here is the verb sense of halting proceedings, as a judge stays an execution.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay a process is to halt it temporarily, synonym of putting it on hold.

clue.text: Entranced over spring-time? Just the reverse!

indicators.note: in a down clue over places one word above the other
the order the clue states is flipped, so the first-named word comes second

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
to bound is to spring or leap

explanation.surface: Is one entranced by springtime, or the other way round?
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring over time' gives BOUND above SPELL; 'Just the reverse!' swaps them.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone spellbound is held as if bewitched, entranced by what they see.

clue.text: He could get one person LBW

definitions.text: He could get one person LBW

parts.words: He could get one person LBW
parts.note: a cricketer who turns the ball might dismiss a batsman leg before wicket

explanation.walkthrough: LBW is leg before wicket, a way a batsman is out in cricket when the ball hits the leg.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow bowler who turns the ball can win a leg before wicket decision, a cricketer type.

clue.text: He is the cause of many a bad thing

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
evil is a bad thing

explanation.surface: Someone responsible for plenty of wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan is traditionally blamed as the source of wickedness in the world.

clue.text: Pair out on the river, having a drink

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge

indicators.note: out means wrong or misplaced, so the word's letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Two people punting on a river and having a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' puts the river first; 'out' turns PAIR into PARI.
explanation.definitionFit: Campari is an Italian bitter aperitif, a drink.

clue.text: Names, landmarks and eyesores, say

indicators.note: say signals that the words are spoken out, so the spelling changes

parts.note: sights are both notable landmarks and ugly things

explanation.surface: A list naming monuments and ugly buildings.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite someone is to name or mention them as an authority.

clue.text: Be punished, do you understand?

definitions.meaning: to be in trouble and take the blame
asked as a question meaning have you grasped it

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both be scolded and grasp a point.

clue.text: Withdrawal from English football team before time

indicators.note: one piece comes before the last

parts.note: a football team has eleven players, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: An English football side leaving before the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An exit is a departure or withdrawal.

clue.text: A bird others turn to

indicators.note: turn signals the word read back to front

parts.note: auks are other seabirds, here standing for others

explanation.surface: A bird that its flockmates look to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'others' are the other birds, AUKS, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The skua is a predatory seabird.

clue.text: Measured and glued

definitions.meaning: size is a gelatinous sealant used in gilding and paper

explanation.definitionFit: The participle means both graded by dimensions and coated with a gluey sealant.

clue.text: Spit in the sea

parts.note: reads as spitting into the water, but a spit is a narrow ridge of land in the water

explanation.definitionFit: A spit is a narrow ridge of deposited sediment offshore, a ridge-like bank.

clue.text: Settle for the account that attracts interest

definitions.meaning: to settle as sediment is to lay down
a savings account that earns interest in Britain is called this

explanation.definitionFit: The word means sediment laid down and a bank account earning interest.

clue.text: Politician makes a defamatory statement about an artist

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to libel is to defame in writing
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.definitionFit: A Liberal is a member of a liberal political party, so a politician.

clue.text: Unusual tale set somewhere in the USA

indicators.note: unusual means out of the ordinary, so the letters are arranged unusually

explanation.surface: A strange story set somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Seattle is a city in Washington State, a place in the USA.

clue.text: Fear of a mischievous child?

definitions.meaning: a naughty child is called a little horror

explanation.definitionFit: The word means intense dread and, informally, a badly behaved child.

clue.text: Place of duty for a nurse going to the front

definitions.text: Place of duty for a nurse
definitions.meaning: a nurse working is out among the hospital beds

explanation.definitionFit: Split, it is where a hospital nurse works; joined, it means forward.

clue.text: Give a signal and slow down

definitions.meaning: to wave a cloth banner as a signal

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to wave down with a banner and to tire or weaken.

clue.text: Roman day that is endless

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: id est is Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A Roman date with no end.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ides was the middle day of a month in the Roman calendar.

clue.text: Protection on landing for party backing American commerce

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour party
trade means commerce

explanation.surface: A political party supporting US trade.
explanation.walkthrough: Landing is the stairwell platform, not an aircraft touching down.
explanation.definitionFit: A balustrade is a railing guarding the edge of a stair landing.

clue.text: One doesn't have to have it

definitions.text: One doesn't have to have it

parts.words: One doesn't have to have it
parts.note: if you don't have to do something, there is no requirement

explanation.definitionFit: A requirement is what one must have; if one doesn't have to, there is none.

clue.text: Correct attire for drill instruction

parts.note: right means correct
dress means attire

explanation.surface: The proper uniform for military drill.
explanation.definitionFit: Right dress is a parade-ground command for soldiers to align themselves.
